values := [3, 8, 11, 15, 19, 24, 27, 31, 36, 42, 47, 53, 58, 64, 70, 77]
targets := [42, 3, 77, 31, 50, 1]
for target := targets[]
    lo := 0
    hi := 15
    found := -1
    print("{target}: probes")
    while lo <= hi
        mid := (lo + hi) / 2
        print(" {mid}")
        if values[mid] == target
            found = mid
            break
        elif values[mid] < target
            lo = mid + 1
        else
            hi = mid - 1
    if found >= 0
        println(" -> index {found}")
    else
        println(" -> not found")
